description.en_US: Right-click the bar's WiFi / Bluetooth indicator icons to open the module's own QML panels: WiFi list with connect + inline password (stock Network service backend), Bluetooth devices with pair/connect/forget (Quickshell's native Bluetooth service). No external tools.
description.zh_TW: 右鍵 bar 上的 WiFi／藍牙指示圖示，開啟模塊自製的 QML 面板：WiFi 列表＋連線＋行內密碼（stock Network 服務後端）、藍牙裝置配對/連線/移除（Quickshell 原生 Bluetooth 服務）。不依賴外部工具。
